set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/numeric-record-ordering
before=$(sha256sum "$base/merged.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
stdout_file=/tmp/merge-conflict.stdout
stderr_file=/tmp/merge-conflict.stderr
trap 'rm -f "$stdout_file" "$stderr_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
if "$base/bin/merge" "$base/exports/west.csv" "$base/conflict.csv" >"$stdout_file" 2>"$stderr_file"; then
    printf 'FAIL: conflicting merge unexpectedly succeeded\n' >&2
    exit 1
else
    status=$?
fi
after=$(sha256sum "$base/merged.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'CONFLICT_EXIT=%s\n' "$status"
printf 'CONFLICT_DIAGNOSTIC\n'; cat "$stderr_file"
printf 'HASH_BEFORE=%s\nHASH_AFTER=%s\n' "$before" "$after"
[ "$status" -ne 0 ]
[ "$before" = "$after" ]
printf 'INTACT_PUBLISHED_CONTENT\n'; cat "$base/merged.csv"
printf 'PASS: conflict stopped publication and existing output remained byte-identical\n'
